title: Beyond the Numbers: Transparency in Relation Extraction Benchmark Creation and Leaderboards

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution of relation types across the NYT and TACRED datasets to highlight significant statistical skewness, such as the overwhelming majority of instances belonging to a 'None' or 'no_relation' class while other specific relations have very few samples.

Qualitatively examining instances labeled via distant supervision (e.g., mapping Freebase relations to NYT text) to demonstrate how the methodology introduces noisy labels, false positives, and implicit reasoning gaps into relation extraction benchmarks.
